projection.source: 2400×1200 equirectangular (plate carrée) candidate globe coordinates; no actual planet coordinate reference yet
projection.eqarea_formula: theta solves 2 theta + sin(2 theta) = PI sin(phi); x=(2 sqrt(2)/PI)*longitudeRadians*cos(theta); y=sqrt(2)*sin(theta)
projection.sampling_algorithm: Point-in-land for each 360x180 midpoint longitude-latitude grid cell; physical spherical surface weighting by cos(latitude).
projection.valid_only_if: Assumed longitude latitude interpolation describes a sphere. Planet oblateness, real coordinates, radius, seas, and ice are not established.

limitations: Mollweide map is for proportional area, not for preserving coast shapes or navigation distances.
V2.25-R geography is wholly candidate, including coastline origin and every latitude.
Rift coast is edited geometry, not a validated plate-tectonic mechanism.
Flat raster rendering by a user browser has not been visually QA-tested.
No elevation, ocean depth, crustal thickness, plate velocity or climate simulations.
planet_scale_note: Absolute surface land area likely larger on the giant planet, but neither individual continental size nor count is tied to Earth's sizes or to a fixed planetary radius multiplier.
